title: Position sensor lost
shortDescription: Aquasure Harmony valve cannot find home position.
fullDescription: Harmony Series digital control valve uses an optical home sensor. Err 1 lights when the controller cannot find home within 4 minutes - usually a stuck piston or debris in the gear train.

fixSteps.title: Manual regen
fixSteps.instruction: Press REGEN to attempt automatic recovery.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drive
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, remove valve cover, check gear train for debris.

title: Cycle step exceeded
shortDescription: Valve did not advance to the next cycle within timeout.
fullDescription: Each regeneration step has a max time. Err 2 means the valve never reached the next position - usually a sticking piston or low-voltage power supply.

fixSteps.title: Test adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm 12VDC at the controller barrel jack.

fixSteps.title: Service piston
fixSteps.instruction: Replace seal/spacer kit and piston if older than 5 years.

title: Memory error
fullDescription: After a brownout the controller may corrupt stored settings. Err 3 prompts a factory reset and re-entry of hardness, salt type, regen day, and time.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold UP+DOWN for 5 seconds, then re-enter settings.

title: Salt level not dropping
shortDescription: Salt bridged in brine tank, no brine forming.
fullDescription: Humidity in the brine tank can cause salt to form a hollow dome that suspends new salt above the water. The result is fresh hardness in the home despite a full tank.

fixSteps.title: Break bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Use a broom handle to break the dome and stir brine.

title: Unit fails to regenerate at scheduled time
shortDescription: Time-of-day clock drifted or 12VDC adapter weak.
fullDescription: Harmony controller relies on the wall adapter for time-keeping. After a power loss longer than 6 hours the schedule may shift. Re-set time and confirm 12VDC.

faq.a: Internal capacitor only - hours not days.

title: Brine tank overfilling
fullDescription: The brine valve assembly has a float that closes the refill at a set level. If the float is stuck or the air check ball lodged, water keeps coming until it overflows.

fixSteps.title: Free float
fixSteps.instruction: Bypass softener, open brine valve, check float moves freely, clean.

faq.a: Standpipe or floor drain - air gap required.

title: Hardness present despite system running
shortDescription: Resin exhausted or bypass valve stuck open.
fullDescription: If post-softener hardness exceeds 1 gpg, either the resin is exhausted, the bypass is open, or the brine cycle is failing.

fixSteps.title: Check bypass
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm bypass arrows point IN and OUT.

fixSteps.title: Manual regen
fixSteps.instruction: Hold REGEN for 3 seconds and verify a complete cycle.

faq.a: Drop test kit at outdoor hose bib.

title: Pressure drops after softener install
shortDescription: Resin bed channeling or pre-filter clogged.
fullDescription: If house pressure drops more than 10 psi across the softener, check pre-sediment filter and run a manual backwash. Channeling can be cleared by air-purging the bed.

fixSteps.title: Backwash
fixSteps.instruction: Hold REGEN to start a backwash and break up channels.

title: Drip at riser tube top
shortDescription: Riser tube O-ring damaged during install.
fullDescription: When the control valve is screwed onto the resin tank, the riser tube O-ring can roll if not lubricated. A drip from the top thread is the symptom.

fixSteps.title: Re-install valve
fixSteps.instruction: Bypass, depressurize, unscrew valve, lubricate riser O-ring with silicone, reseat.

title: Salty taste at faucet after regen
shortDescription: Brine not rinsed completely from resin bed.
fullDescription: If a regen is interrupted, brine remains in the resin bed and tastes salty. Run a manual REGEN to flush, or run cold water at outside hose for 15 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Force rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Hold REGEN to start full cycle and let it complete.

faq.a: Salty water is high sodium - not for low-sodium diets.
